title: fix(plugin-report,plugin-form): a dataset report and an authored-parent line-items panel re-read on the data-invalidation bus (objectui#10814)
body:
Fixes #10814
Clause-②: no — two read-on-mount blocks gain a data-invalidation reader; no declared key, export or accept set moves

This unblocks objectui#10519 (decision B, "readers first"): after PR objectui#10777 removes `PageView`'s remount, these two blocks would otherwise keep pre-action data. No closing keyword applies to that card here.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 PM (claim comment 5858298916, triage 5858057995), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY` (`mode:subagent`, so that id is also this run's). Branch `claude/issue-10814-report-line-items-bus-reader`, cut from `origin/main` `33e58d81a1` (BASE); head `a9d23bf`.

## What changed

Each read now names the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for the object it queries, the objectui#10623 / objectui#10778 shape (same hook, same matcher `dataChangeMatches`, no second channel, no remount):

- `packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, `useDatasetRows`: `useDataInvalidation(state.object)`, the dataset's base object as the query's answer names it (the key `ObjectChart`'s dataset arm reads, objectui#10035, reused in place: no new shared export). The nonce joins the fetch effect's dependencies. A run for the same selection signature is a re-read of the rows on screen, so it keeps them drawn and swaps them for the answer; a new signature still starts from "Running report…".
- `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`: `useDataInvalidation(dataSource && parentId ? schema.childObject : undefined)`, and the nonce joins the fetch effect that runs `load('inputs')`. So the rule that already governs an input change governs a bus event too: unsaved edits for the current parent HOLD the re-read, and the save's reload carries it (objectui#10712 R3). A re-read that asks for exactly what the last run asked for, over rows held for this parent, keeps the grid drawn (`refreshing`) and disables it until the answer lands, the way the save path disables it (objectui#10631).
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DrillDownDrawer.tsx`: **not edited.** Its `drillDown.report` arm renders `spec-report` through `SchemaRenderer`, so it re-reads with the report renderer's own reader (pinned, see below).
- Pins: `DatasetReportRenderer.invalidationRefetch-10814.test.tsx` (plugin-report `__tests__`), `LineItemsPanel.invalidationRefetch-10814.test.tsx` (plugin-form), `drillDownReport.invalidationRefetch-10814.test.tsx` (`apps/console/src/__tests__`).
- `.changeset/10814-report-line-items-bus-readers.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-report`: patch, `@object-ui/plugin-form`: patch).

Where the drawer pin lives, and why: the drawer is in `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, and the `spec-report` it dispatches to is registered by `@object-ui/plugin-report`, which plugin-dashboard does not depend on. `apps/console` depends on both, so the pin runs there with the real pairing, and no dependency is added.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **G1 (which effects query).** One. Every dataset presentation (tabular / summary table, matrix, embedded chart, each joined block) funnels through `useDatasetRows`, whose effect is the only `queryDataset` call in the package. The second effect the dispatch named is `useRegistryComponent`'s lazy chart-registry subscription; it queries nothing. So the reader sits in `useDatasetRows` once and covers all of them. Pinned: a joined report with a summary block and a matrix block goes 2 → 4 reads after `'*'`; a summary report with an embedded chart goes 2 → 4, the chart's and the table's query each re-read.
- **G2 (the object an answer names).** `state.object`, which the hook already kept from the answer. Nothing subscribes until an answer names it; idle, error and no-object answers do not subscribe.
- **G3 (line items).** The read is `load`'s `find(childObject, { $filter: { [relationshipField]: parentId } … })`. `dataChangeMatches` scopes a `recordId` to a record OF the object named, and these rows are many children of one parent, so the subscription is object-level on the child object.
- **G4 (drawer).** Needs no edit: pinned through the real drawer.
- **G5 (re-read keeps the block).** Both blocks swapped their rows for a placeholder on a re-read at BASE (`setState({ status: 'loading', rows: [] })` → "Running report…"; `setLoading(true)` → "Loading…"). Repaired in the same effects as above. No refresh bar is drawn: `report.*` has no `refreshing` string in the locale packs and adding one is outside this card, the same as `object-pivot` in PR objectui#10809.

## Pins and ablation

Every pin renders through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the package's own registration, with a bare `useDataInvalidation` reader as the lit control, and settles each read by hand so it can look at the block while a re-read is in flight:

- per block: one read on mount, a second after `'*'` (and, in flight, the table / matrix / grid node is the same node and no loading line is drawn), one after its own object, none after an unrelated object;
- report: the `report` key and the `spec-report` key; the joined blocks and the embedded chart;
- line items: an authored `parentId` with NO record context; the re-read is held over unsaved edits and the save's reload carries it (exactly two reads);
- controls: a legacy presentation report over authored rows and a line-items panel with no parent issue no read on `'*'`.

No `dist/` preflight applies: the pins import their package through source, and the vitest alias map resolves `@object-ui/*` to source.

## Gates (head `a9d23bf`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-report/ packages/plugin-form/ apps/console/src/__tests__/drillDownReport.invalidationRefetch-10814.test.tsx`: `Test Files 156 passed (156)`, `Tests 1801 passed | 1 skipped (1802)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (script names echoed; each `tsconfig.test.json` lists its pin, counted with `--listFiles`: 1 and 1), after `turbo run build` of both dependency closures plus `plugin-dashboard`: exit 0 each.
- The console pin, narrowed: `tsc --noEmit` over a throwaway project extending `apps/console/tsconfig.json` with only that file (deleted after): exit 0. The first run caught TS6133 (an unused React import under the console's `noUnusedLocals`), repaired in `a9d23bf`. The full console type-check needs every package built and is CI's.
- Lint, narrowed and measured: `eslint --format json` over the five touched source and test files read 5 files, 0 errors, 30 warnings, exit 0. Per-rule counts of the two source files equal BASE's (with `--no-inline-config`, the same one pre-existing `react-hooks/static-components` error on BASE and head, whose inline disable CI's `eslint .` honours). `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and the diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.
- `check:phantom-deps` ✅; `check:new-line-citations` `VERDICT … 0 new citation(s)`; `check:control-bytes` OK; `check:test-path-roots` OK; `check:vi-mock-specifiers` OK; `check:vi-mock-inherit` OK; `check:unreferenced-sources` OK; `check:pending-changeset-literals` ✅; `check:changeset-claims` ✅; `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅ (1 changeset); `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` ✅.
- CI owns the repo-wide lint and the full test run.

## Serial

- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against a fresh `origin/main` (`fda49e5`, fetched into a private ref): clean. No commit on main since BASE touches these files.
- Files are disjoint from the in-flight siblings: objectui#10815 (`DashboardRenderer.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`), objectui#10799 (`Calendar` callers), PR objectui#10819 (`ObjectDataTable.tsx`, `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx`), PR objectui#10777 (`PageView`).

## Acceptance notes

**Not changed here. Each is read at source, not run:**
- A dataset answer that names no `object` (the field is optional on the adapter's answer) subscribes to nothing, so it does not re-read even on `'*'`. That is the `ObjectChart` dataset arm's behaviour too, kept on purpose so the two readers agree.
- A joined dataset (several base objects) keys on the one base object the answer names; a write to a joined-in object alone does not re-read it. `'*'`, which `PageView` will send, does.
- With the console's mutation bridge mounted, the adapter's `batchTransaction` emits a mutation per op, so the panel's own save echoes on the bus. By the ordering read at source (the echo's render lands after the save's reload is issued, while the panel is still dirty), the echo is held and replayed once after that reload commits: one extra read after a save, in place (no second "Loading…"). The pin's adapter has no `onMutation`, so this is not pinned. The save's own reload keeps its loading branch, as before.
- The line-items subscription is on the child object only. A write declared on the PARENT object (a record action that rewrites lines server-side and announces the parent) does not re-read the lines; `'*'` does.

**The drawer's report arm (`DrillDownDrawer.tsx`), read at source, not run; no producer found:** the arm chooses the report body by the pre-9.0 shape (`columns` is an array, or `objectName` is present), so a dataset `summary` / `tabular` drill report with no `columns` falls through to the record list; and it merges the drill scope into `report.filter`, which the dataset renderer has refused since objectui#5137 (a dev warning, and the report renders without the drill scope). `drillDown.report` has no producer in objectstack's `examples/` or this repo's `examples/`: `drillDown` itself has 0 file hits in either, against a control (`dataset`) of 37 and 7. So neither is filed here.
